id-20261124-news-2.title: Community Organizations May Manage Mines: Policy Goals, Permit Requirements, and Governance and Environmental Risks

segments.src: Kebijakan yang membuka peluang bagi organisasi kemasyarakatan (ormas) untuk mengelola konsesi tambang memicu diskusi luas.
segments.tr: A policy that opens opportunities for community organizations (ormas) to manage mining concessions has sparked wide discussion.

segments.src: Pendukungnya menilai langkah ini dapat memperluas manfaat sumber daya alam.
segments.tr: Supporters argue this step could expand the benefits of natural resources.

segments.src: Pengkritiknya mengingatkan bahwa pertambangan adalah sektor padat modal, berteknologi tinggi, dan berisiko besar.
segments.tr: Critics warn that mining is a capital-intensive, high-technology, and high-risk sector.

segments.src: Artikel ini merangkum garis besar kebijakan tersebut dan hal-hal yang perlu dicermati publik.
segments.tr: This article summarizes the outline of the policy and the points the public should scrutinize.

segments.src: Isinya bersifat informasi umum, bukan nasihat hukum atau investasi.
segments.tr: The content is general information, not legal or investment advice.

segments.src: ## Apa yang Berubah?
segments.tr: ## What Has Changed?

segments.src: Pada 2024, pemerintah menerbitkan Peraturan Pemerintah Nomor 25 Tahun 2024 yang mengubah aturan pelaksanaan kegiatan usaha pertambangan mineral dan batu bara.
segments.tr: In 2024, the government issued Government Regulation No. 25 of 2024, which amended the implementing rules for metal and coal mining business activities.

segments.src: Aturan ini membuka jalan bagi badan usaha milik ormas keagamaan untuk mendapatkan Wilayah Izin Usaha Pertambangan Khusus (WIUPK) dengan mekanisme penawaran prioritas.
segments.tr: The regulation paves the way for business entities owned by religious community organizations to obtain a Special Mining Business Permit Area (WIUPK) through a priority offer mechanism.

segments.src: Wilayah yang ditawarkan umumnya berasal dari bekas perjanjian karya atau kontrak batu bara yang telah berakhir.
segments.tr: The areas offered generally come from former work agreements or coal contracts that have expired.

segments.src: Pembahasan mengenai perluasan peluang bagi pihak lain, seperti koperasi, usaha kecil dan menengah, serta perguruan tinggi, juga muncul dalam pembaruan regulasi pertambangan berikutnya.
segments.tr: Discussion of expanding opportunities for other parties, such as cooperatives, micro, small and medium enterprises, and universities, has also emerged in the next round of mining regulatory reforms.

segments.src: Karena aturan dapat berubah, pembaca sebaiknya memeriksa teks resmi terbaru di laman Kementerian Energi dan Sumber Daya Mineral (ESDM) atau Jaringan Dokumentasi dan Informasi Hukum.
segments.tr: Because rules can change, readers should check the latest official text on the website of the Ministry of Energy and Mineral Resources (ESDM) or the National Legal Documentation and Information Network.

segments.src: ## Alasan di Balik Kebijakan
segments.tr: ## Reasons Behind the Policy

segments.src: Pemerintah dan pendukung kebijakan biasanya menyampaikan beberapa alasan berikut:
segments.tr: The government and policy supporters typically cite the following reasons:

segments.src: - **Pemerataan manfaat.** Hasil tambang diharapkan tidak hanya dinikmati korporasi besar, tetapi juga organisasi yang memiliki jaringan layanan sosial.
segments.tr: - **Equitable distribution of benefits.** Mining proceeds are expected to be enjoyed not only by large corporations, but also by organizations with networks of social services.

segments.src: - **Pendanaan kegiatan sosial.** Ormas mengelola sekolah, rumah sakit, panti, dan program pemberdayaan. Keuntungan usaha dapat menjadi sumber pembiayaan tambahan.
segments.tr: - **Funding social activities.** Community organizations run schools, hospitals, orphanages, and empowerment programs. Business profits can serve as an additional source of funding.

segments.src: - **Pengakuan peran historis.** Banyak ormas berkontribusi pada pendidikan, kesehatan, dan layanan masyarakat sejak lama.
segments.tr: - **Recognition of historical role.** Many community organizations have long contributed to education, health, and public services.

segments.src: - **Pemanfaatan wilayah bekas konsesi.** Lahan yang kontraknya telah selesai dapat dialokasikan kembali agar tidak terbengkalai.
segments.tr: - **Use of former concession areas.** Land whose contracts have ended can be reallocated so it does not lie idle.

segments.src: ## Syarat dan Mekanisme Izin
segments.tr: ## Permit Requirements and Mechanism

segments.src: Secara garis besar, proses yang lazim berlaku adalah sebagai berikut:
segments.tr: Broadly, the commonly applied process is as follows:

segments.src: 1. **Penawaran prioritas.** Pemerintah menetapkan wilayah dan menawarkannya kepada pihak yang memenuhi kriteria.
segments.tr: 1. **Priority offer.** The government designates an area and offers it to parties that meet the criteria.

segments.src: 2. **Badan usaha.** Izin tidak diberikan langsung kepada organisasi. Ormas perlu mendirikan badan usaha, dan kepemilikan sahamnya diatur agar mayoritas dikendalikan ormas.
segments.tr: 2. **Business entity.** The permit is not granted directly to the organization. The organization must establish a business entity, and its share ownership is arranged so that the majority is controlled by the organization.

segments.src: 3. **Kelengkapan administrasi.** Pemohon menyerahkan dokumen legalitas, rencana kerja, dan komitmen pengelolaan.
segments.tr: 3. **Administrative completeness.** The applicant submits legal documents, a work plan, and a management commitment.

segments.src: 4. **Evaluasi teknis, lingkungan, dan finansial.** Pemerintah menilai kemampuan pemohon sebelum menerbitkan WIUPK.
segments.tr: 4. **Technical, environmental, and financial evaluation.** The government assesses the applicant's capabilities before issuing the WIUPK.

segments.src: 5. **Larangan pengalihan.** Aturan umumnya melarang pemindahan izin atau saham secara bebas kepada pihak lain tanpa persetujuan. Tujuannya mencegah izin hanya menjadi alat perantara.
segments.tr: 5. **Transfer prohibition.** The rules generally prohibit freely transferring the permit or shares to other parties without approval. The aim is to prevent permits from becoming mere intermediary tools.

segments.src: Rincian persyaratan dapat berbeda tiap wilayah dan dapat diperbarui, sehingga rujukan utama tetap peraturan resmi.
segments.tr: Detailed requirements may differ by region and may be updated, so the official regulation remains the primary reference.

segments.src: ## Kesiapan Teknis
segments.tr: ## Technical Readiness

segments.src: Tambang menuntut kemampuan yang tidak sederhana.
segments.tr: Mining demands no simple capabilities.

segments.src: Beberapa hal yang perlu dipastikan:
segments.tr: Several things must be ensured:

segments.src: - **Modal besar.** Eksplorasi, alat berat, infrastruktur, dan reklamasi membutuhkan dana jangka panjang.
segments.tr: - **Large capital.** Exploration, heavy equipment, infrastructure, and reclamation require long-term funding.

segments.src: - **Tenaga ahli.** Geologi, teknik pertambangan, keselamatan kerja, dan pengelolaan lingkungan membutuhkan profesional bersertifikat.
segments.tr: - **Expert personnel.** Geology, mining engineering, occupational safety, and environmental management require certified professionals.

segments.src: - **Kemitraan operator.** Banyak badan usaha baru menggandeng kontraktor atau mitra berpengalaman. Skema ini sah, tetapi perlu terbuka agar tidak menimbulkan konflik kepentingan.
segments.tr: - **Operator partnerships.** Many new business entities partner with experienced contractors or partners. This scheme is legitimate, but it must be open to avoid conflicts of interest.

segments.src: - **Studi kelayakan.** Cadangan, harga komoditas, dan biaya operasional harus dihitung realistis sebelum berkomitmen.
segments.tr: - **Feasibility studies.** Reserves, commodity prices, and operating costs must be calculated realistically before commitments are made.

segments.src: ## Risiko Tata Kelola
segments.tr: ## Governance Risks

segments.src: Pengawasan publik penting karena beberapa potensi masalah berikut:
segments.tr: Public oversight is important because of several potential problems:

segments.src: - **Konflik kepentingan.** Peran ormas sebagai lembaga sosial dan sebagai pelaku bisnis dapat bersinggungan. Pemisahan yang jelas antara pengurus organisasi dan pengelola usaha perlu dijaga.
segments.tr: - **Conflict of interest.** The organization's role as a social institution and as a business actor may overlap. A clear separation between organizational leadership and business management must be maintained.

segments.src: - **Transparansi.** Publik berhak mengetahui siapa pemilik manfaat, bagaimana mitra dipilih, dan ke mana hasil usaha disalurkan.
segments.tr: - **Transparency.** The public has the right to know who the beneficial owners are, how partners are selected, and where business proceeds are directed.

segments.src: - **Objektivitas penetapan.** Kriteria penerima dan penetapan wilayah sebaiknya terbuka agar tidak menimbulkan kesan keberpihakan.
segments.tr: - **Objectivity of designation.** Recipient criteria and area designation should be open to avoid the impression of favoritism.

segments.src: - **Akuntabilitas keuangan.** Laporan keuangan yang diaudit dan dipublikasikan dapat memperkuat kepercayaan anggota dan masyarakat.
segments.tr: - **Financial accountability.** Audited and published financial reports can strengthen the trust of members and the public.

segments.src: ## Risiko Lingkungan dan Sosial
segments.tr: ## Environmental and Social Risks

segments.src: Pertambangan membawa dampak yang nyata bila tidak dikelola dengan baik:
segments.tr: Mining has real impacts if not managed properly:

segments.src: - Perubahan bentang alam, deforestasi, dan hilangnya keanekaragaman hayati.
segments.tr: - Alteration of landscapes, deforestation, and loss of biodiversity.

segments.src: - Pencemaran air dan udara serta sedimentasi sungai.
segments.tr: - Water and air pollution, and river sedimentation.

segments.src: - Lubang bekas tambang yang tidak direklamasi dan berisiko bagi warga.
segments.tr: - Unreclaimed former mine pits that pose risks to residents.

segments.src: - Konflik lahan dengan masyarakat sekitar, termasuk masyarakat adat.
segments.tr: - Land conflicts with surrounding communities, including indigenous peoples.

segments.src: - Risiko keselamatan dan kesehatan kerja.
segments.tr: - Occupational safety and health risks.

segments.src: Pemegang izin wajib menyusun dokumen lingkungan, menempatkan jaminan reklamasi dan pascatambang, serta menjalankan rencana pemantauan.
segments.tr: Permit holders must prepare environmental documents, provide reclamation and post-mining guarantees, and carry out monitoring plans.

segments.src: Kepatuhan di lapangan perlu diperiksa secara berkala oleh instansi berwenang.
segments.tr: Compliance in the field should be inspected regularly by the competent authorities.

segments.src: ## Apa yang Bisa Dipantau Publik?
segments.tr: ## What Can the Public Monitor?

segments.src: - Dokumen perizinan dan peta wilayah yang dipublikasikan pemerintah.
segments.tr: - Permit documents and area maps published by the government.

segments.src: - Laporan pelaksanaan reklamasi dan pascatambang.
segments.tr: - Reports on reclamation and post-mining implementation.

segments.src: - Pelaporan penerimaan negara dan program tanggung jawab sosial.
segments.tr: - Reports on state revenue and social responsibility programs.

segments.src: - Hasil audit dan pengawasan oleh inspektur tambang.
segments.tr: - Audit results and oversight by mine inspectors.

segments.src: - Pemberitaan dan laporan dari lembaga independen serta akademisi.
segments.tr: - Reporting from independent institutions and academics.

segments.src: ## Penutup
segments.tr: ## Closing

segments.src: Kebijakan ini dapat membuka peluang pemerataan manfaat, tetapi keberhasilannya bergantung pada kesiapan teknis, keterbukaan, dan penegakan standar lingkungan.
segments.tr: This policy may open opportunities for a more equitable distribution of benefits, but its success depends on technical readiness, openness, and enforcement of environmental standards.

segments.src: Penilaian yang adil memerlukan data, bukan sekadar dukungan atau penolakan.
segments.tr: A fair assessment requires data, not merely support or rejection.

segments.src: Publik dianjurkan membaca sumber resmi dan menimbang beragam sudut pandang sebelum menyimpulkan.
segments.tr: The public is encouraged to read official sources and weigh diverse perspectives before drawing conclusions.

segments.tr: *This article is informative.

segments.src: Rincian regulasi dapat berubah, jadi periksa peraturan terbaru dari sumber resmi pemerintah.*
segments.tr: Regulatory details may change, so check the latest regulations from official government sources.*

id-20261124-consumer-advertising-psychol.title: [Consumer Psychology #14] Why Is Your Online Shopping Cart Always Fuller Than Planned?

segments.src: > Di dunia digital, keputusan belanja kita dibentuk oleh tiga kekuatan besar: algoritma rekomendasi, ulasan orang lain, dan desain yang memancing pembelian impulsif.
segments.tr: > In the digital world, our shopping decisions are shaped by three major forces: recommendation algorithms, reviews from others, and designs that trigger impulsive purchases.

segments.src: ## Konsep Hari Ini
segments.tr: ## Concept of the Day

segments.src: Psikologi konsumen mempelajari *bagaimana* orang memutuskan untuk membeli, dan sering kali keputusan itu tidak serasional yang kita kira.
segments.tr: Consumer psychology studies *how* people decide to buy, and often those decisions are not as rational as we think.

segments.src: Perilaku konsumen digital adalah cara orang mencari, menilai, dan membeli produk lewat layar, misalnya di marketplace, media sosial, atau aplikasi pesan antar.
segments.tr: Digital consumer behavior is how people search for, evaluate, and buy products through screens, for example on marketplaces, social media, or food delivery apps.

segments.src: Ada tiga mekanisme utama yang bekerja di sana.
segments.tr: There are three main mechanisms at work there.

segments.src: Algoritma rekomendasi**
segments.tr: Recommendation algorithms**

segments.src: Platform mencatat apa yang kamu lihat, klik, simpan, dan beli, lalu menebak apa yang mungkin kamu suka berikutnya.
segments.tr: Platforms record what you view, click, save, and buy, then guess what you might like next.

segments.src: Bagian seperti "Produk serupa" atau "Pembeli ini juga membeli" mengurangi usaha mencari.
segments.tr: Sections like "Similar products" or "Customers also bought" reduce the effort of searching.

segments.src: Secara psikologis, ini memanfaatkan kecenderungan kita untuk memilih jalan yang paling mudah.
segments.tr: Psychologically, this leverages our tendency to choose the path of least resistance.

segments.src: Pilihan yang muncul di depan mata lebih sering dipilih dibanding pilihan yang harus dicari sendiri.
segments.tr: Options that appear right in front of our eyes are chosen more often than options we have to search for ourselves.

segments.src: Ulasan dan rating (bukti sosial)**
segments.tr: Reviews and ratings (social proof)**

segments.src: Saat tidak bisa memegang barang secara langsung, kita mengandalkan pengalaman orang lain.
segments.tr: When we cannot hold an item directly, we rely on the experiences of others.

segments.src: Ini disebut *social proof* atau bukti sosial: kalau banyak orang memilih sesuatu, kita menganggapnya pilihan yang aman.
segments.tr: This is called *social proof*: if many people choose something, we assume it is a safe choice.

segments.src: Penelitian tentang ulasan online secara konsisten menunjukkan bahwa jumlah ulasan dan rata-rata bintang memengaruhi kemungkinan orang membeli.
segments.tr: Research on online reviews consistently shows that the number of reviews and the average star rating influence the likelihood of people buying.

segments.src: Menariknya, rating yang terlalu sempurna (misalnya 5,0 dari sedikit ulasan) kadang justru dicurigai, sehingga produk dengan rating sekitar 4,5 dan banyak ulasan sering terasa lebih meyakinkan.
segments.tr: Interestingly, ratings that are too perfect (e.g., 5.0 from a few reviews) are sometimes actually viewed with suspicion, so products with a rating around 4.5 and many reviews often feel more convincing.

segments.src: Pembelian impulsif**
segments.tr: Impulsive buying**

segments.src: Pembelian impulsif adalah membeli secara spontan tanpa rencana sebelumnya.
segments.tr: Impulsive buying is buying spontaneously without prior planning.

segments.src: Di dunia digital, hambatannya makin kecil: pembayaran satu klik, paylater, gratis ongkir, dan hitung mundur flash sale.
segments.tr: In the digital world, the barriers are getting smaller: one-click payments, paylater, free shipping, and flash sale countdowns.

segments.src: Rasa takut ketinggalan (*FOMO*) dan kesan langka ("Sisa 3 lagi!")
segments.tr: The fear of missing out (*FOMO*) and the impression of scarcity ("Only 3 left!")

segments.src: mendorong kita memutuskan dengan cepat, sebelum sempat berpikir panjang.
segments.tr: push us to decide quickly, before we have time to think long and hard.

segments.src: Ketiganya saling menguatkan: algoritma menyodorkan produk, ulasan memberi rasa aman, dan desain promo membuat kita membeli *sekarang*.
segments.tr: All three reinforce each other: the algorithm suggests products, reviews provide a sense of security, and promotional designs make us buy *now*.

segments.src: ## Dalam Kehidupan Sehari-hari
segments.tr: ## In Daily Life

segments.src: Bayangkan Rina, karyawan di Jakarta, membuka aplikasi marketplace saat jam istirahat hanya untuk membeli kabel charger seharga Rp35.000.
segments.tr: Imagine Rina, an employee in Jakarta, opening a marketplace app during her break just to buy a charging cable for Rp35.000.

segments.src: Di halaman produk, muncul rekomendasi "Sering dibeli bersama": casing HP dan powerbank.
segments.tr: On the product page, a "Frequently bought together" recommendation appears: a phone case and a power bank.

segments.src: Powerbank itu punya rating 4,8 dari 12 ribu ulasan, dan ada label "Flash Sale berakhir dalam 00:14:59" dengan harga coret dari Rp299.000 menjadi Rp189.000.
segments.tr: The power bank has a 4.8 rating from 12 thousand reviews, and there is a "Flash Sale ends in 00:14:59" label with the price crossed out from Rp299.000 to Rp189.000.

segments.src: Rina tidak berencana membeli powerbank.
segments.tr: Rina did not plan to buy a power bank.

segments.src: Tapi rekomendasi membuatnya terlihat relevan, ribuan ulasan membuatnya terasa aman, dan hitung mundur membuatnya merasa harus memutuskan sekarang.
segments.tr: But the recommendation made it look relevant, thousands of reviews made it feel safe, and the countdown made her feel she had to decide now.

segments.src: Ditambah opsi paylater "cicilan 0%", akhirnya total belanja Rina menjadi Rp224.000, lebih dari enam kali lipat rencana awalnya.
segments.tr: Added with the "0% installment" paylater option, Rina's total shopping finally became Rp224.000, more than six times her original plan.

segments.src: Apakah Rina salah?
segments.tr: Is Rina wrong?

segments.src: Belum tentu.
segments.tr: Not necessarily.

segments.src: Powerbank itu mungkin memang berguna.
segments.tr: The power bank might actually be useful.

segments.src: Intinya, keputusan itu sebagian besar dibentuk oleh lingkungan digital, bukan oleh rencana awalnya.
segments.tr: The point is, the decision was largely shaped by the digital environment, not by her original plan.

segments.src: ## 3 Poin Penting
segments.tr: ## 3 Key Points

segments.src: 1. Algoritma rekomendasi mempermudah pilihan dengan menampilkan produk yang diperkirakan cocok, sehingga kita cenderung memilih yang ada di depan mata.
segments.tr: 1. Recommendation algorithms simplify choices by displaying products estimated to be suitable, so we tend to choose what is in front of our eyes.

segments.src: 2. Ulasan dan rating bekerja sebagai bukti sosial yang mengurangi rasa ragu saat kita tidak bisa melihat barang secara langsung.
segments.tr: 2. Reviews and ratings work as social proof that reduces doubt when we cannot see the items directly.

segments.src: 3. Fitur seperti flash sale, stok terbatas, dan pembayaran instan menurunkan hambatan sehingga pembelian impulsif lebih mudah terjadi.
segments.tr: 3. Features like flash sales, limited stock, and instant payments lower barriers so that impulsive purchases are more likely to happen.

segments.src: ## ✅ Kuis Mandiri
segments.tr: ## ✅ Self-Quiz

segments.src: **1.** Bagian "Pembeli ini juga membeli" di marketplace adalah contoh dari...
segments.tr: **1.** The "Customers also bought" section on a marketplace is an example of...

segments.src: a) Bukti sosial
segments.tr: a) Social proof

segments.src: b) Algoritma rekomendasi
segments.tr: b) Recommendation algorithm

segments.src: c) Kelangkaan
segments.tr: c) Scarcity

segments.src: **2.** O/X: Produk dengan rating 5,0 dari 3 ulasan selalu lebih dipercaya konsumen daripada produk dengan rating 4,6 dari 5.000 ulasan.
segments.tr: **2.** T/F: A product with a 5.0 rating from 3 reviews is always trusted more by consumers than a product with a 4.6 rating from 5,000 reviews.

segments.src: **3.** Label "Sisa 2 lagi!"
segments.tr: **3.** The "Only 2 left!" label

segments.src: dan hitung mundur flash sale terutama mendorong...
segments.tr: and flash sale countdowns primarily encourage...

segments.src: a) Pembelian impulsif karena rasa takut ketinggalan
segments.tr: a) Impulsive buying due to fear of missing out

segments.src: b) Konsumen membandingkan harga lebih lama
segments.tr: b) Consumers to compare prices longer

segments.src: c) Konsumen membaca semua ulasan dulu
segments.tr: c) Consumers to read all reviews first

segments.src: ## 📚 Istilah Hari Ini
segments.tr: ## 📚 Terms of the Day

segments.src: - **Algoritma rekomendasi**: sistem yang memakai data perilaku pengguna untuk menebak dan menampilkan produk yang mungkin diminati.
segments.tr: - **Recommendation algorithm**: a system that uses user behavior data to guess and display products that might be of interest.

segments.src: - **Bukti sosial (social proof)**: kecenderungan mengikuti pilihan atau penilaian orang lain saat kita ragu.
segments.tr: - **Social proof**: the tendency to follow the choices or judgments of others when we are in doubt.

segments.src: - **Pembelian impulsif**: pembelian spontan tanpa rencana, sering dipicu emosi atau situasi sesaat.
segments.tr: - **Impulsive buying**: spontaneous purchase without a plan, often triggered by emotions or momentary situations.

segments.src: - **FOMO (fear of missing out)**: rasa cemas akan kehilangan kesempatan yang dimiliki orang lain.
segments.tr: - **FOMO (fear of missing out)**: anxiety about missing an opportunity that others have.

segments.src: - **Efek kelangkaan**: kecenderungan menilai sesuatu lebih berharga ketika jumlah atau waktunya terlihat terbatas.
segments.tr: - **Scarcity effect**: the tendency to value something more when its quantity or time appears limited.

segments.src: *Jawaban: 1) b — Rekomendasi berbasis data pembelian orang lain adalah kerja algoritma (meski bisa ikut memanfaatkan bukti sosial).
segments.tr: *Answers: 1) b — Recommendations based on other people's purchase data are the work of algorithms (though they can also utilize social proof).

segments.src: 2) X — Jumlah ulasan yang banyak umumnya lebih meyakinkan; rating sempurna dari sedikit ulasan sering dianggap kurang bisa dipercaya.
segments.tr: 2) F — A large number of reviews is generally more convincing; a perfect rating from few reviews is often considered less trustworthy.

segments.src: 3) a — Kelangkaan dan batas waktu memicu FOMO sehingga orang memutuskan cepat tanpa banyak menimbang.*
segments.tr: 3) a — Scarcity and time limits trigger FOMO so that people decide quickly without weighing much.*

id-20261124-news-1.title: APBN 2027 Rp4.106 Trillion: How to Read State Spending, a Deficit Below 3 Percent, and a Still-Low Tax Ratio

segments.src: Setiap tahun, angka besar dalam Anggaran Pendapatan dan Belanja Negara (APBN) menjadi bahan pemberitaan.
segments.tr: Every year, the large figures in the State Budget (APBN, Anggaran Pendapatan dan Belanja Negara) become news.

segments.src: Untuk 2027, pemerintah menyiapkan rancangan belanja sekitar Rp4.106 triliun dengan defisit yang dijaga di bawah 3 persen dari produk domestik bruto (PDB).
segments.tr: For 2027, the government has prepared a draft spending plan of around Rp4.106 trillion, with the deficit kept below 3 percent of gross domestic product (GDP).

segments.src: Di sisi lain, rasio pajak Indonesia disebut baru sekitar 11,8 persen.
segments.tr: Meanwhile, Indonesia's tax ratio is reported to be only around 11.8 percent.

segments.src: Angka-angka ini terdengar jauh dari kehidupan sehari-hari, padahal berkaitan langsung dengan sekolah, puskesmas, jalan, subsidi, dan pajak yang dibayar warga.
segments.tr: These figures can seem far removed from everyday life, yet they are directly tied to schools, community health centers (puskesmas), roads, subsidies, and the taxes citizens pay.

segments.src: Artikel ini membantu pembaca memahami cara membaca angka-angka tersebut.
segments.tr: This article helps readers understand how to read these figures.

segments.src: Seluruh angka mengacu pada rancangan yang disampaikan pemerintah.
segments.tr: All figures refer to the draft presented by the government.

segments.src: Angka final dapat berubah setelah pembahasan bersama DPR, jadi pembaca disarankan mengecek dokumen resmi Kementerian Keuangan.
segments.tr: Final figures may change after joint deliberation with the DPR (House of Representatives), so readers are advised to check the official documents of the Ministry of Finance.

segments.src: ## Apa itu APBN?
segments.tr: ## What Is the APBN?

segments.src: APBN adalah rencana keuangan tahunan pemerintah pusat.
segments.tr: The APBN is the central government's annual financial plan.

segments.src: Isinya tiga hal pokok:
segments.tr: It contains three main things:

segments.src: - **Pendapatan negara**: uang yang masuk, terutama dari pajak, kepabeanan dan cukai, serta penerimaan negara bukan pajak (PNBP).
segments.tr: - **State revenue**: money coming in, mainly from taxes, customs and excise, and non-tax state revenue (PNBP).

segments.src: - **Belanja negara**: uang yang dikeluarkan, baik untuk kementerian dan lembaga maupun untuk transfer ke daerah.
segments.tr: - **State spending**: money going out, both for ministries and agencies and for transfers to the regions.

segments.src: - **Pembiayaan**: cara menutup selisih bila belanja lebih besar daripada pendapatan, misalnya dengan menerbitkan surat utang.
segments.tr: - **Financing**: how the gap is covered when spending exceeds revenue, for example by issuing government bonds.

segments.src: APBN disusun pemerintah, dibahas bersama DPR, lalu ditetapkan dengan undang-undang.
segments.tr: The APBN is drawn up by the government, deliberated with the DPR, and then enacted as a law.

segments.src: Karena itu, APBN bukan sekadar daftar angka, melainkan hasil kesepakatan politik tentang prioritas.
segments.tr: For that reason, the APBN is not merely a list of numbers but the result of a political agreement on priorities.

segments.src: ## Dari mana uang negara datang?
segments.tr: ## Where Does the Government's Money Come From?

segments.src: Sumber terbesar pendapatan negara adalah penerimaan perpajakan.
segments.tr: The largest source of state revenue is tax revenue.

segments.src: Di dalamnya ada pajak penghasilan (PPh), pajak pertambahan nilai (PPN), pajak bumi dan bangunan, serta bea dan cukai.
segments.tr: It includes income tax (PPh), value-added tax (PPN), land and building tax, and customs and excise duties.

segments.src: Sumber lainnya adalah PNBP, misalnya dari pengelolaan sumber daya alam, dividen badan usaha milik negara, dan layanan pemerintah.
segments.tr: Other sources are PNBP, for example from the management of natural resources, dividends from state-owned enterprises (BUMN), and government services.

segments.src: Karena porsi pajak sangat besar, kesehatan penerimaan pajak sangat menentukan ruang gerak anggaran.
segments.tr: Because taxes make up such a large share, the health of tax revenue largely determines how much room the budget has.

segments.src: Ketika ekonomi tumbuh baik, penerimaan umumnya naik.
segments.tr: When the economy grows well, revenue generally rises.

segments.src: Ketika harga komoditas turun atau aktivitas usaha melambat, penerimaan bisa tertekan.
segments.tr: When commodity prices fall or business activity slows, revenue can come under pressure.

segments.src: ## Ke mana uang negara pergi?
segments.tr: ## Where Does the Government's Money Go?

segments.src: Belanja negara umumnya dibagi menjadi dua kelompok besar:
segments.tr: State spending is generally divided into two major groups:

segments.src: 1. **Belanja pemerintah pusat**, yang mencakup belanja kementerian dan lembaga, subsidi dan bantuan sosial, serta pembayaran bunga utang.
segments.tr: 1. **Central government spending**, which covers ministry and agency spending, subsidies and social assistance, and interest payments on debt.

segments.src: 2. **Transfer ke daerah**, yaitu dana yang dialirkan ke pemerintah provinsi, kabupaten, dan kota untuk membiayai layanan di wilayah masing-masing.
segments.tr: 2. **Transfers to the regions**, that is, funds channeled to provincial, regency, and city governments to finance services in their respective areas.

segments.src: Konstitusi dan undang-undang juga menetapkan alokasi wajib, misalnya anggaran pendidikan sebesar 20 persen dari belanja negara.
segments.tr: The constitution and laws also set mandatory allocations, for example the education budget of 20 percent of state spending.

segments.src: Karena ada belanja yang sifatnya wajib atau sulit diubah, seperti gaji aparatur dan bunga utang, ruang untuk program baru sering lebih sempit daripada yang dibayangkan.
segments.tr: Because some spending is mandatory or hard to change, such as civil servant salaries and debt interest, the room for new programs is often narrower than people imagine.

segments.src: ## Apa arti defisit di bawah 3 persen?
segments.tr: ## What Does a Deficit Below 3 Percent Mean?

segments.src: Defisit terjadi ketika belanja lebih besar daripada pendapatan.
segments.tr: A deficit occurs when spending exceeds revenue.

segments.src: Undang-undang keuangan negara membatasi defisit APBN maksimal 3 persen dari PDB.
segments.tr: State finance law limits the APBN deficit to a maximum of 3 percent of GDP.

segments.src: Batas ini dimaksudkan agar utang tidak membengkak tanpa kendali.
segments.tr: The limit is meant to keep debt from ballooning out of control.

segments.src: Defisit bukan otomatis buruk.
segments.tr: A deficit is not automatically bad.

segments.src: Banyak negara memakai defisit untuk menjaga ekonomi saat melambat atau untuk membiayai investasi jangka panjang seperti infrastruktur dan pendidikan.
segments.tr: Many countries use deficits to support the economy when it slows, or to finance long-term investment such as infrastructure and education.

segments.src: Yang perlu diperhatikan adalah:
segments.tr: What needs attention is:

segments.src: - **Besarnya defisit** dibandingkan ukuran ekonomi.
segments.tr: - **The size of the deficit** compared with the size of the economy.

segments.src: - **Biaya bunga** yang harus dibayar atas utang.
segments.tr: - **Interest costs** that must be paid on the debt.

segments.src: - **Kegunaan dana**: apakah dipakai untuk belanja produktif atau sekadar konsumtif.
segments.tr: - **How the funds are used**: whether for productive spending or merely consumption.

segments.src: - **Keberlanjutan**: apakah penerimaan negara cukup kuat untuk menopang kewajiban di masa depan.
segments.tr: - **Sustainability**: whether state revenue is strong enough to support future obligations.

segments.src: Menjaga defisit di bawah 3 persen memberi sinyal disiplin fiskal kepada investor dan lembaga pemeringkat.
segments.tr: Keeping the deficit below 3 percent signals fiscal discipline to investors and credit rating agencies.

segments.src: Namun disiplin saja tidak cukup bila kualitas belanja rendah.
segments.tr: But discipline alone is not enough if the quality of spending is low.

segments.src: ## Rasio pajak 11,8 persen: mengapa jadi sorotan?
segments.tr: ## The 11.8 Percent Tax Ratio: Why Is It in the Spotlight?

segments.src: Rasio pajak adalah perbandingan penerimaan pajak terhadap PDB.
segments.tr: The tax ratio is the comparison of tax revenue to GDP.

segments.src: Angka sekitar 11,8 persen menunjukkan bahwa dari setiap Rp100 nilai ekonomi yang dihasilkan, sekitar Rp11,8 kembali ke negara sebagai pajak.
segments.tr: A figure of around 11.8 percent means that of every Rp100 in economic value produced, about Rp11.8 flows back to the state as tax.

segments.src: Angka ini tergolong rendah dibandingkan sejumlah negara tetangga dan rata-rata negara berpendapatan menengah.
segments.tr: This figure is considered low compared with a number of neighboring countries and the average of middle-income countries.

segments.src: Beberapa penyebab yang sering dibahas para ahli:
segments.tr: Some causes often discussed by experts:

segments.src: - **Ekonomi informal yang besar**, sehingga sebagian aktivitas usaha sulit tercatat.
segments.tr: - **A large informal economy**, so some business activity is hard to record.

segments.src: - **Tingkat kepatuhan** wajib pajak yang masih bisa ditingkatkan.
segments.tr: - **The level of taxpayer compliance**, which can still be improved.

segments.src: - **Insentif dan pengecualian pajak** yang mengurangi basis pajak.
segments.tr: - **Tax incentives and exemptions** that shrink the tax base.

segments.src: - **Ketergantungan pada komoditas**, yang membuat penerimaan naik turun mengikuti harga global.
segments.tr: - **Dependence on commodities**, which makes revenue rise and fall with global prices.

segments.src: Rasio pajak yang rendah berarti negara punya lebih sedikit uang untuk layanan publik tanpa harus berutang.
segments.tr: A low tax ratio means the state has less money for public services without having to borrow.

segments.src: Meski demikian, menaikkan rasio pajak tidak harus berarti menaikkan tarif.
segments.tr: However, raising the tax ratio does not necessarily mean raising tax rates.

segments.src: Banyak ahli menyarankan memperluas basis pajak, memperbaiki administrasi, memanfaatkan data dan teknologi, serta meningkatkan kepatuhan.
segments.tr: Many experts recommend broadening the tax base, improving administration, making use of data and technology, and boosting compliance.

segments.src: ## Apa artinya bagi layanan publik?
segments.tr: ## What Does It Mean for Public Services?

segments.src: Anggaran besar tidak otomatis berarti layanan baik.
segments.tr: A large budget does not automatically mean good services.

segments.src: Kualitas layanan bergantung pada ketepatan sasaran, kemampuan pelaksana, dan pengawasan.
segments.tr: Service quality depends on targeting accuracy, implementers' capacity, and oversight.

segments.src: Beberapa hal yang bisa dicermati warga:
segments.tr: Some things citizens can keep an eye on:

segments.src: - **Pendidikan dan kesehatan**: seberapa besar alokasinya, dan apakah sampai ke sekolah serta fasilitas kesehatan di daerah.
segments.tr: - **Education and health**: how large the allocations are, and whether they reach schools and health facilities in the regions.

segments.src: - **Perlindungan sosial**: apakah bantuan tepat sasaran dan datanya diperbarui.
segments.tr: - **Social protection**: whether assistance is well targeted and whether its data is kept up to date.

segments.src: - **Infrastruktur**: apakah proyek dipilih berdasarkan manfaat nyata dan dirawat setelah selesai.
segments.tr: - **Infrastructure**: whether projects are chosen based on real benefits and maintained after completion.

segments.src: - **Bunga utang**: semakin besar porsinya, semakin kecil ruang untuk program lain.
segments.tr: - **Debt interest**: the larger its share, the less room there is for other programs.

segments.src: ## Apa artinya bagi beban pajak warga?
segments.tr: ## What Does It Mean for Citizens' Tax Burden?

segments.src: Rancangan anggaran tidak otomatis berarti pajak baru.
segments.tr: A draft budget does not automatically mean new taxes.

segments.src: Tarif pajak ditentukan oleh undang-undang dan peraturan turunannya, sehingga setiap perubahan harus melalui proses hukum yang jelas.
segments.tr: Tax rates are set by law and its implementing regulations, so any change must go through a clear legal process.

segments.src: Warga tetap sebaiknya mengikuti informasi resmi, misalnya soal batas penghasilan tidak kena pajak, tarif PPN, atau insentif untuk usaha kecil.
segments.tr: Citizens should still follow official information, for example on the non-taxable income threshold, the VAT rate, or incentives for small businesses.

segments.src: Bagi pekerja dan pelaku usaha, langkah praktis yang bermanfaat adalah memahami hak dan kewajiban perpajakan, menyimpan pencatatan keuangan dengan rapi, dan memakai kanal resmi Direktorat Jenderal Pajak untuk bertanya atau melapor.
segments.tr: For workers and business operators, a practical step that helps is to understand their tax rights and obligations, keep their financial records in order, and use the official channels of the Directorate General of Taxes to ask questions or file reports.

segments.src: ## Cara membaca berita APBN dengan kritis
segments.tr: ## How to Read APBN News Critically

segments.src: 1. **Lihat sumber angka.** Bedakan antara rancangan, outlook, dan realisasi.
segments.tr: 1. **Check the source of the figures.** Distinguish between the draft, the outlook, and the realization.

segments.src: 2. **Bandingkan dengan PDB.** Angka triliunan rupiah baru bermakna bila dibandingkan dengan ukuran ekonomi.
segments.tr: 2. **Compare with GDP.** Trillion-rupiah figures only become meaningful when compared with the size of the economy.

segments.src: 3. **Periksa komposisi.** Total belanja kurang informatif dibanding rincian per fungsi dan program.
segments.tr: 3. **Examine the composition.** A total spending figure is less informative than the breakdown by function and program.

segments.src: 4. **Cermati asumsi.** Pertumbuhan ekonomi, nilai tukar, suku bunga, dan harga minyak memengaruhi hitungan.
segments.tr: 4. **Scrutinize the assumptions.** Economic growth, exchange rates, interest rates, and oil prices affect the calculations.

segments.src: 5. **Ikuti realisasinya.** Laporan semester dan laporan keuangan pemerintah menunjukkan apakah rencana berjalan.
segments.tr: 5. **Follow up on realization.** Semester reports and government financial statements show whether the plan is on track.

segments.src: ## Penutup
segments.tr: ## Closing

segments.src: APBN 2027 sebesar sekitar Rp4.106 triliun mencerminkan upaya pemerintah menyeimbangkan kebutuhan belanja, disiplin defisit di bawah 3 persen, dan penerimaan pajak yang masih terbatas.
segments.tr: The 2027 APBN of around Rp4.106 trillion reflects the government's effort to balance spending needs, deficit discipline below 3 percent, and tax revenue that remains limited.

segments.src: Rasio pajak sekitar 11,8 persen menjadi pengingat bahwa kekuatan anggaran bergantung pada basis penerimaan yang sehat.
segments.tr: A tax ratio of around 11.8 percent is a reminder that the strength of the budget depends on a healthy revenue base.

segments.src: Dengan memahami dasar-dasarnya, warga dapat menilai pemberitaan secara lebih tenang, membedakan rencana dari kenyataan, dan ikut mengawasi penggunaan uang publik.
segments.tr: By understanding the basics, citizens can assess the news more calmly, distinguish plans from reality, and help oversee the use of public money.

segments.src: *Catatan: Artikel ini bersifat informasi umum dan bukan nasihat keuangan atau perpajakan.
segments.tr: *Note: This article is general information and not financial or tax advice.

segments.src: Untuk angka terbaru, rujuk dokumen resmi Kementerian Keuangan dan DPR.*
segments.tr: For the latest figures, refer to the official documents of the Ministry of Finance and the DPR.*

id-20261124-news-3.title: Black Friday and Harbolnas 12.12: How to Tell Real Discounts from Prices Raised First

segments.src: Akhir tahun identik dengan musim diskon.
segments.tr: The end of the year is synonymous with sale season.

segments.src: Dimulai dari Black Friday di penghujung November, lalu berlanjut ke Harbolnas 12.12 pada Desember, hampir semua platform belanja daring berlomba menawarkan potongan harga.
segments.tr: Starting with Black Friday at the end of November and continuing to Harbolnas 12.12 in December, almost every online shopping platform competes to offer price cuts.

segments.src: Bagi konsumen, ini peluang menghemat.
segments.tr: For consumers, this is an opportunity to save.

segments.src: Namun di tengah banner "diskon hingga 90%", tidak semua penawaran sungguh-sungguh murah.
segments.tr: But amid banners saying "up to 90% off," not every offer is truly cheap.

segments.src: Panduan ini membantu Anda memeriksa harga, mengenali diskon semu, memahami hak sebagai konsumen, dan menjaga anggaran tetap aman.
segments.tr: This guide helps you check prices, recognize fake discounts, understand your rights as a consumer, and keep your budget safe.

segments.src: ## Mengapa Perlu Waspada?
segments.tr: ## Why Be Cautious?

segments.src: Diskon yang menarik memicu keputusan cepat.
segments.tr: An attractive discount triggers quick decisions.

segments.src: Penjual dan platform memakai penghitung waktu mundur, label "stok tinggal sedikit", dan harga coret berwarna merah agar pembeli merasa harus segera membayar.
segments.tr: Sellers and platforms use countdown timers, "only a few left in stock" labels, and red strikethrough prices so buyers feel they must pay right away.

segments.src: Tidak semuanya menyesatkan, tetapi pola ini bisa mendorong pembelian impulsif.
segments.tr: Not all of it is misleading, but these patterns can drive impulse purchases.

segments.src: Karena itu, hal pertama yang perlu dilakukan adalah memperlambat keputusan dan memeriksa fakta.
segments.tr: So the first thing to do is slow down your decision and check the facts.

segments.src: ## Mengenali Diskon Semu
segments.tr: ## Recognizing Fake Discounts

segments.src: Diskon semu terjadi ketika harga "sebelum diskon" tidak pernah benar-benar dipakai untuk berjualan, atau dinaikkan sesaat sebelum periode promo.
segments.tr: A fake discount happens when the "before discount" price was never actually used for selling, or was raised just before the promo period.

segments.src: Beberapa tanda yang perlu dicermati:
segments.tr: Some signs to watch for:

segments.src: - **Harga coret yang tidak masuk akal.** Harga awal jauh di atas harga pasar produk sejenis di toko lain.
segments.tr: - **Unreasonable strikethrough prices.** The original price is far above the market price of similar products at other stores.

segments.src: - **Kenaikan harga mendadak.** Harga naik beberapa hari sebelum promo, lalu "turun" ke level semula.
segments.tr: - **Sudden price increases.** The price goes up a few days before the promo, then "drops" back to its original level.

segments.src: - **Potongan besar pada produk tanpa merek jelas.** Diskon 80 sampai 90% pada barang yang tidak punya harga acuan sering kali hanya permainan angka.
segments.tr: - **Big discounts on products without a clear brand.** An 80 to 90% discount on items with no reference price is often just a numbers game.

segments.src: - **Kupon yang rumit.** Harga akhir baru terlihat setelah syarat minimum belanja, kuota, dan jam tertentu terpenuhi.
segments.tr: - **Complicated coupons.** The final price only becomes visible after minimum purchase requirements, quotas, and specific hours are met.

segments.src: - **Ongkos kirim atau biaya layanan yang membengkak.** Harga barang tampak murah, tetapi total pembayaran tidak jauh berbeda.
segments.tr: - **Inflated shipping or service fees.** The item looks cheap, but the total payment is not much different.

segments.src: ## Cara Memeriksa Riwayat Harga
segments.tr: ## How to Check Price History

segments.src: 1. **Catat harga sejak jauh hari.** Masukkan produk incaran ke daftar keinginan (wishlist) atau keranjang dua sampai tiga minggu sebelum promo, lalu catat harganya dengan tangkapan layar.
segments.tr: 1. **Track prices well in advance.** Add the target product to your wishlist or cart two to three weeks before the promo, and record its price with screenshots.

segments.src: 2. **Bandingkan di beberapa platform.** Cek produk yang sama di beberapa marketplace, toko resmi merek, dan toko fisik. Gunakan nomor model atau SKU agar yang dibandingkan benar-benar barang yang sama.
segments.tr: 2. **Compare across several platforms.** Check the same product on several marketplaces, brand official stores, and physical stores. Use the model number or SKU so you are comparing the exact same item.

segments.src: 3. **Gunakan fitur pelacak harga.** Sebagian marketplace menampilkan grafik atau notifikasi turun harga. Ada pula situs perbandingan harga dan ekstensi peramban dari pihak ketiga. Perlakukan datanya sebagai petunjuk, bukan kepastian, karena cakupan dan keakuratannya berbeda-beda.
segments.tr: 3. **Use price-tracking features.** Some marketplaces show price charts or price-drop notifications. There are also price comparison sites and third-party browser extensions. Treat their data as clues, not certainties, since their coverage and accuracy vary.

segments.src: 4. **Hitung harga akhir.** Jumlahkan harga barang, ongkos kirim, biaya layanan, asuransi, dan potongan voucher. Bandingkan angka total, bukan hanya persentase diskon.
segments.tr: 4. **Calculate the final price.** Add up the item price, shipping, service fees, insurance, and voucher discounts. Compare the total, not just the discount percentage.

segments.src: 5. **Periksa ulasan terbaru.** Ulasan beberapa bulan terakhir lebih relevan untuk menilai kualitas, keaslian barang, dan reputasi penjual.
segments.tr: 5. **Check recent reviews.** Reviews from the last few months are more relevant for assessing quality, authenticity, and seller reputation.

segments.src: ## Tips Memilih Penjual dan Produk
segments.tr: ## Tips for Choosing Sellers and Products

segments.src: - Utamakan toko resmi atau penjual dengan rekam jejak panjang, penilaian tinggi, dan respons yang baik.
segments.tr: - Prioritize official stores or sellers with a long track record, high ratings, and good responsiveness.

segments.src: - Waspadai akun baru dengan harga jauh di bawah pasar. Harga yang terlalu murah bisa menandakan barang palsu, bekas, atau penipuan.
segments.tr: - Be wary of new accounts with prices far below market. Prices that are too cheap can signal counterfeit, used, or fraudulent goods.

segments.src: - Baca deskripsi produk dengan teliti: ukuran, spesifikasi, garansi, dan kebijakan retur.
segments.tr: - Read product descriptions carefully: sizes, specifications, warranty, and return policy.

segments.src: - Gunakan metode pembayaran yang aman dan dilindungi platform. Hindari memindahkan transaksi ke luar aplikasi atau mentransfer langsung ke rekening pribadi atas permintaan penjual.
segments.tr: - Use safe payment methods protected by the platform. Avoid moving transactions outside the app or transferring money directly to a personal account at a seller's request.

segments.src: - Jangan membagikan kode OTP, PIN, atau kata sandi kepada siapa pun, termasuk pihak yang mengaku sebagai admin toko.
segments.tr: - Never share OTP codes, PINs, or passwords with anyone, including people claiming to be store admins.

segments.src: ## Hak Konsumen Saat Belanja Online
segments.tr: ## Consumer Rights When Shopping Online

segments.src: Di Indonesia, hak konsumen diatur dalam Undang-Undang Nomor 8 Tahun 1999 tentang Perlindungan Konsumen.
segments.tr: In Indonesia, consumer rights are governed by Law No. 8 of 1999 on Consumer Protection.

segments.src: Beberapa hak yang relevan bagi pembeli daring antara lain:
segments.tr: Some rights relevant to online buyers include:

segments.src: - **Hak atas informasi yang benar, jelas, dan jujur** mengenai kondisi, jaminan, dan harga barang. Iklan atau potongan harga yang menyesatkan dapat dipermasalahkan.
segments.tr: - **The right to correct, clear, and honest information** about the condition, guarantees, and price of goods. Misleading advertisements or discounts can be challenged.

segments.src: - **Hak atas kenyamanan, keamanan, dan keselamatan** dalam menggunakan barang.
segments.tr: - **The right to comfort, security, and safety** when using goods.

segments.src: - **Hak untuk didengar** keluhannya dan mendapatkan penyelesaian sengketa secara patut.
segments.tr: - **The right to be heard** regarding complaints and to receive fair dispute resolution.

segments.src: - **Hak atas kompensasi, ganti rugi, atau penggantian** apabila barang yang diterima tidak sesuai dengan perjanjian atau tidak sebagaimana mestinya.
segments.tr: - **The right to compensation, indemnification, or replacement** if the goods received do not conform to the agreement or are not as they should be.

segments.src: Ketentuan perdagangan melalui sistem elektronik juga diatur dalam peraturan turunan, termasuk kewajiban pelaku usaha menyediakan informasi yang lengkap dan benar.
segments.tr: Provisions on electronic-system trade are also set out in implementing regulations, including the obligation of business operators to provide complete and accurate information.

segments.src: Kebijakan detail, seperti batas waktu pengajuan retur, dapat berbeda antarplatform dan antarkategori produk, sehingga selalu baca syarat dan ketentuan yang berlaku.
segments.tr: Detailed policies, such as the deadline for return requests, can differ between platforms and product categories, so always read the applicable terms and conditions.

segments.src: ## Retur dan Pengembalian Dana: Langkah Praktis
segments.tr: ## Returns and Refunds: Practical Steps

segments.src: 1. **Rekam saat membuka paket.** Video tanpa jeda dari paket yang masih tersegel hingga isinya menjadi bukti kuat jika barang rusak atau salah kirim.
segments.tr: 1. **Record when you open the package.** An uninterrupted video from the sealed package until its contents are revealed is strong evidence if goods are damaged or wrongly sent.

segments.src: 2. **Periksa segera.** Cek kondisi dan kelengkapan barang begitu paket diterima, sebelum menekan tombol "Pesanan Diterima".
segments.tr: 2. **Inspect immediately.** Check the condition and completeness of the goods as soon as the package arrives, before pressing the "Order Received" button.

segments.src: 3. **Ajukan komplain dalam batas waktu.** Gunakan fitur pengajuan pengembalian di aplikasi, lampirkan foto, video, dan nomor pesanan.
segments.tr: 3. **File a complaint within the deadline.** Use the return request feature in the app and attach photos, videos, and the order number.

segments.src: 4. **Simpan semua bukti.** Tangkapan layar halaman produk, percakapan dengan penjual, bukti pembayaran, dan resi pengiriman.
segments.tr: 4. **Keep all evidence.** Screenshots of the product page, conversations with the seller, proof of payment, and shipping receipts.

segments.src: 5. **Pahami pengecualian.** Beberapa barang, misalnya produk yang dibuat khusus atau barang kebersihan pribadi yang segelnya sudah dibuka, biasanya tidak dapat diretur kecuali cacat atau tidak sesuai.
segments.tr: 5. **Understand the exceptions.** Some items, such as custom-made products or personal hygiene goods with an opened seal, usually cannot be returned unless they are defective or not as described.

segments.src: ## Jika Masalah Tidak Selesai
segments.tr: ## If the Problem Is Not Resolved

segments.src: Berikut urutan yang umumnya dapat ditempuh:
segments.tr: The following sequence can generally be followed:

segments.src: 1. Hubungi penjual melalui fitur chat resmi dan sampaikan keluhan secara jelas serta sopan.
segments.tr: 1. Contact the seller through the platform's official chat feature and state your complaint clearly and politely.

segments.src: 2. Ajukan sengketa atau banding melalui pusat bantuan platform.
segments.tr: 2. File a dispute or appeal through the platform's help center.

segments.src: 3. Sampaikan pengaduan ke layanan konsumen resmi, misalnya kanal pengaduan Kementerian Perdagangan, Badan Perlindungan Konsumen Nasional (BPKN), atau lembaga perlindungan konsumen swadaya masyarakat. Periksa situs resmi masing-masing untuk kanal dan prosedur terbaru.
segments.tr: 3. Submit a complaint to official consumer service channels, such as the complaint channel of the Ministry of Trade, the National Consumer Protection Agency (BPKN), or a community-based consumer protection organization (LPKSM). Check each official website for the latest channels and procedures.

segments.src: 4. Untuk sengketa yang tidak terselesaikan, konsumen dapat menempuh Badan Penyelesaian Sengketa Konsumen (BPSK) di daerah masing-masing.
segments.tr: 4. For disputes that remain unresolved, consumers can pursue the Consumer Dispute Settlement Agency (BPSK) in their region.

segments.src: 5. Jika menduga ada penipuan atau penyalahgunaan data, laporkan ke platform, bank atau penyedia dompet digital, dan pihak berwajib.
segments.tr: 5. If you suspect fraud or data misuse, report it to the platform, your bank or digital wallet provider, and the authorities.

segments.src: ## Mengatur Anggaran agar Tidak Jebol
segments.tr: ## Managing Your Budget So It Doesn't Blow Up

segments.src: Musim diskon sering membuat pengeluaran melonjak tanpa terasa.
segments.tr: Sale season often makes spending rise without you noticing.

segments.src: Beberapa kebiasaan berikut dapat membantu:
segments.tr: The following habits can help:

segments.src: - **Buat daftar kebutuhan dan batas belanja.** Tentukan total anggaran sebelum membuka aplikasi dan patuhi angka itu.
segments.tr: - **Make a list of needs and set a spending limit.** Set the total budget before opening the app and stick to that number.

segments.src: - **Bedakan kebutuhan dan keinginan.** Tanyakan: apakah saya tetap membelinya jika harganya normal?
segments.tr: - **Distinguish needs from wants.** Ask yourself: would I still buy it if the price were normal?

segments.src: - **Terapkan aturan jeda 24 jam.** Untuk barang yang tidak mendesak, tunggu sehari sebelum membayar.
segments.tr: - **Apply a 24-hour waiting rule.** For non-urgent items, wait a day before paying.

segments.src: - **Waspadai cicilan dan paylater.** Cicilan nol persen sering disertai biaya admin atau syarat tertentu. Hitung total kewajiban bulanan dan pastikan tidak mengganggu kebutuhan pokok serta dana darurat.
segments.tr: - **Be wary of installments and paylater.** Zero-percent installments often come with admin fees or specific conditions. Calculate your total monthly obligation and make sure it does not disrupt basic needs or your emergency fund.

segments.src: - **Batasi jumlah kartu dan metode bayar.** Semakin banyak metode, semakin sulit melacak pengeluaran.
segments.tr: - **Limit the number of cards and payment methods.** The more methods you use, the harder it is to track spending.

segments.src: - **Catat pengeluaran.** Gunakan aplikasi pencatat keuangan atau lembar kerja sederhana agar sisa anggaran selalu terlihat.
segments.tr: - **Record your expenses.** Use a personal finance app or a simple spreadsheet so your remaining budget is always visible.

segments.src: - **Manfaatkan cashback dan voucher secara bijak.** Keuntungan tambahan hanya berarti jika Anda memang akan membeli barang tersebut.
segments.tr: - **Use cashback and vouchers wisely.** Extra savings only matter if you were going to buy the item anyway.

segments.src: ## Daftar Periksa Singkat Sebelum Membayar
segments.tr: ## Quick Checklist Before Paying

segments.src: - [ ] Apakah produk ini memang saya butuhkan?
segments.tr: - [ ] Do I really need this product?

segments.src: - [ ] Apakah harga akhir sudah saya bandingkan di beberapa tempat?
segments.tr: - [ ] Have I compared the final price across several places?

segments.src: - [ ] Apakah penjual tepercaya dan ulasannya baru?
segments.tr: - [ ] Is the seller trustworthy, and are the reviews recent?

segments.src: - [ ] Apakah kebijakan retur dan garansi jelas?
segments.tr: - [ ] Are the return and warranty policies clear?

segments.src: - [ ] Apakah total belanja masih dalam batas anggaran?
segments.tr: - [ ] Is the total spending still within my budget?

segments.src: - [ ] Apakah saya membayar lewat jalur resmi di dalam aplikasi?
segments.tr: - [ ] Am I paying through the official in-app channel?

segments.src: ## Penutup
segments.tr: ## Closing

segments.src: Black Friday dan Harbolnas 12.12 bisa menjadi momen menghemat jika dijalani dengan persiapan.
segments.tr: Black Friday and Harbolnas 12.12 can be a moment to save if approached with preparation.

segments.src: Kuncinya sederhana: catat harga sebelum promo, bandingkan total biaya, pilih penjual tepercaya, kenali hak sebagai konsumen, dan disiplin pada anggaran.
segments.tr: The key is simple: record prices before the promo, compare total costs, choose trusted sellers, know your rights as a consumer, and stay disciplined with your budget.

segments.src: Dengan begitu, Anda tidak hanya mendapat harga yang baik, tetapi juga terhindar dari penyesalan setelah belanja.
segments.tr: That way, you not only get a good price but also avoid regret after shopping.
